cnd3:1.1: This was said by the Blessed One while he was staying among the Magadhans at the Pāsāṇaka Shrine. When requested by the sixteen brahmin attendants, and asked each question in turn, he answered the question.
cnd3:1.2: If one understands the meaning and the teaching of each single question and practices in line with the teaching, one would surely go to the far shore of old age and death.
cnd3:1.4: Therefore the designation of this exposition of the teaching is simply the Way to the Far Shore.
